title: Engineering Sync
summary: The team reviewed progress on the checkout rewrite and agreed the payment service migration is on track for the end of the sprint. Marcus flagged flaky integration tests in CI as the main risk; Dana volunteered to quarantine the worst offenders so releases aren't blocked. The group decided to cut a release candidate on Thursday and postpone the search indexing work to next sprint to protect the checkout deadline.

chapter_summaries.title: Checkout Rewrite & Migration Status
chapter_summaries.description: Marcus reported the payment service migration is basically done and on track for end of sprint. Dana raised flaky CI integration tests as the main blocker and offered to quarantine the three worst offenders so they stop failing the pipeline, with a proper fix to follow next week.

chapter_summaries.title: Release Candidate & Scope Decisions
chapter_summaries.description: The group agreed to cut a release candidate on Thursday, contingent on a rollback runbook Marcus will own. To protect the checkout deadline they decided to defer the search indexing work to next sprint and move those tickets in Jira.

action_items: Dana Whitfield will quarantine the three flakiest payment integration tests in CI.
Priya Nair will cut the checkout release candidate on Thursday.
Marcus Lee will write the migration rollback runbook by Wednesday.
Priya Nair will move the search indexing tickets to next sprint in Jira.
key_questions: Do we have a rollback path if the payment migration fails mid-release?
Can we ship checkout without the new search indexing?

turns.text: Morning everyone. Let's start with the checkout rewrite — where are we?
Payment service migration is basically done. I'm confident we hit end of sprint.
The blocker is CI. The payment integration tests are flaky and they keep failing the pipeline.
It's the same three tests every time. They're timing-dependent.
I can quarantine those three so they don't block releases, then fix them properly next week.
Do that. I don't want flaky tests holding up a release candidate.
Speaking of which — can we cut an RC Thursday?
Yes, as long as the rollback runbook exists. If the migration goes wrong mid-release we need a way back.
Marcus, can you own the rollback runbook before Thursday?
What about the search indexing work? That's also due this sprint.
Let's push search indexing to next sprint. Checkout is the priority and I'd rather protect that deadline.
Works for me. I'll move those tickets in Jira.
Great. Tomás is out today, I'll catch him up async. Thanks all.
